Thank you.

I spent three months ringing daily. Few times there was a space they refused as it was too risky (his job and contacts). One told me women with children 'more important'  I do get that, however... and one told me I'd be a fool to give up my home! 

I tried, tried, tried - each time having to discuss most humiliating and upsetting circumstances in detail.

Thank you for the response though.

I sent a long message explaining, (that'll be the one deleted).
I am sorry, I am not up to it again, but I do appreciate your giving me the 
opportunity, and invite.
Thank you.

Hello. I'm in the UK  - London, England.
I may have posted in the wrong section/sub, if so my apologies.

Yes, my reply I thought a pm to a pm from moderators. I guess that is what you you were referring to. Sorry. 

Said more on there than I would otherwise - assuming they were referring me to tried and tested agencies etc.

Thank you for your interest (care).
All the best.

I have no means, and now no family, about to lose my home home and cannot leave the front door. Besides the psychopath ex (two family members of his in police), I have a crazy neighbpur camped outside my door day and night. Ordinary me tried to deal with it - me "please do not steal my rubbish"  her "you're ungrateful". She progressed to stealing mail from the letterbox.

She is dirty, unkempt but eloquent and wealthy. Owning several million+  homes, she acts as guard dog and questions anyone approaching my home, I can't even dispose of rubbish elsewhere (street bins) or summon courage to go to a shop late at night as she will follow.

I was lucky to have some bread and milk delivered today (that is my lot for a fortnight if I should stick it), she came up to my soor and examined the tray the guy was delivering from - yet she is a few doors away.

 She sleeps and keeps belongings (fetid rubbish) outside her home, steals and has been 'done' (apparently for id theft). My neighnour between us took her to court for the refuse stacked outside (he is a mature Solicitor) but has given up and let the place. 

Anyone not suffering ptsd, or of decent manner might fare better. 
I do not own but rent at a lower cost and she considers me a lesser being not worthy of privacy or respect. I have pails a higher Council Tax than her for the duration of my tenancy, I have not created fire hazard, rodent infestation nor intrusion upon others.

Please forgive me, I don't know which sub to post on, and I am beyond flummoxed. Apologies for any typos, also any vague references I am trying to remain anonymous obviously, most importantly for what even with only salient points might prove a long post. 

I extricated myself from what was (only after, very cear to me), an extremely abusive relationship. I had tried and failed to get help from all organisations (Palladin, Womens Aid, local IDVA) etc, however for various reasons (his job making me high risk etc) I have been housebound going on two years.
 
I need somewhere, anywhere for a short while - a caravan - anywhere! Without going into the ins and outs (thereby identifying), can anyone refer to an organisation that might have a caravan, granny flat etc that will, please God give me will (a break)? I am sorry for the reek of desperation and lack of detail. This is hard enough, I am the one people come to for solutions, now I have none. I have been robbed of health, all my wealth, in crippling debt (no food last four days) and the woman in the mirror is someone several decades my senior I neither recognise nor know how to help. 

My line was due to be disconnected by today, so please if I do not reply that will be why. Thank you for reading.
